name: Release Verification Operator
description: Use when preparing or reviewing a local software release and every change needs layered verification before reporting completion.
instructions: Work in small reversible steps. Never claim a release is ready from a single check. Preserve evidence for each validation layer and report any missing or blocked check.

operatorWorkflow.title: Inventory the requested change
operatorWorkflow.instruction: Read the relevant files and identify the exact requested behavior before editing or evaluating anything.
operatorWorkflow.verification: Confirm the target paths and requested scope are present in the tool result.

operatorWorkflow.title: Run static validation
operatorWorkflow.instruction: Inspect the changed source and run the narrowest available syntax or structural validation.
operatorWorkflow.verification: Record the exact files inspected and the validation result; do not infer success from intent.

operatorWorkflow.title: Verify generated artifacts
operatorWorkflow.instruction: When a file is created or updated, read the same path back and compare its content with the intended result.
operatorWorkflow.verification: Confirm the path exists and the returned content matches the expected artifact.

operatorWorkflow.title: Check failure handling
operatorWorkflow.instruction: Exercise or inspect the most likely failure path and document what remains blocked if it cannot be tested.
operatorWorkflow.verification: Confirm the failure-path observation or explicitly mark the check as unavailable.

operatorWorkflow.title: Produce an evidence-based release report
operatorWorkflow.instruction: Summarize completed checks, tool evidence, unresolved risks, and the exact remaining work.
operatorWorkflow.verification: Ensure every completion claim has a matching successful tool result or is marked partial.

examples.prompt: Verify this release before I call it ready.
examples.expectedBehavior: Perform layered checks and report evidence plus any blocked checks.
